title: Redmi 17C 5G lands in India, here are the prices
description: Redmi initially launched the 17C 5G in some markets in August, and today the device has finally arrived in India. It will become available on October 7 starting at INR 20,999 ($218). For that amount of cash, you get the variant with 4GB of RAM. If you want 6GB of RAM, you will have to pay INR 22,999 ($238). Both of those have 128GB of storage. The Redmi 17C 5G comes with a 6.9-inch LCD screen with 720x1600 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera, an 8MP selfie camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery with support for 33W charging. title: Samsung Galaxy M08 and F08 are now official
description: Today Samsung has quietly listed both the Galaxy M08 and F08 on its website in India. This makes the two devices official, and they are both in fact clones of the Galaxy A08 with different names. Like the A08, the M08 and F08 each have a 6.7-inch LCD screen with 720x1600 resolution and a 90Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera with f/1.8 aperture and autofocus, a 2MP depth sensor, an 8MP selfie camera, and a 6,000mAh battery with support for 25W charging. title: Poco C95 Pro launches with a 7,500mAh battery and 6.9 inch display
description: Xiaomi has launched the Poco C95 Pro in select regions globally, including the EU and Singapore. The key highlights of the Poco C95 Pro include a 7,500mAh battery with support for 45W wired charging and a large 6.9 inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate and Gorilla Glass 7i protection. The handset is powered by the MediaTek Helio G91 Ultra chipset, paired with up to 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB of eMMC 5.1 storage. For photography, the Poco C95 Pro features a 50MP primary rear camera alongside an auxiliary lens. An 8MP front camera handles selfies and video calls. Other...

title: RedMagic 12 Pro+ runs Geekbench, confirms its chipset and RAM amount
description: RedMagic started teasing its next flagship smartphone, the 12 Pro+, last month. The device will become official on October 15. Ahead of that, someone in possession of a prototype has decided to run Geekbench on it. As always, that has resulted in a listing in the benchmark’s online database. As you can see, it managed a single-core score of 3,354 and a multi-core score of 11,448 in Geekbench 7.1.0 for Android. title: Samsung unveils Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on earphones
description: Just a day after leaked images of Samsung’s first clip-on earphones surfaced online, the company has officially unveiled the Galaxy Buds On in South Korea. The Galaxy Buds On feature a clip type design that is claimed to be comfortable for extended periods of use, including during outdoor activities such as running. The open design also allows users to remain aware of their surroundings. The earphones support touch controls for music playback and calls, with sensors positioned at the back of the buds. description: The brand-new Mate 90 Pro Max is an impressive phone on its own, but Huawei has an even more special version dubbed Mate 90 RS Ultimate Design. It’s a nod to previous Ultimate Design Huawei phones and features a more premium look than the Mate 90 Pro Max while retaining its key hardware specs. description: Today, we're unboxing the vivo V80 Lite. This vivo V80 Lite, specifically, not this vivo V80 Lite (which is for the Indian market). Confusing, we know. The global vivo V80 Lite ships in Green, Pink, and Black (ours) in a box with a 44W charger, a USB cable, and a color-matching case. The case is one of those grippy rubber ones vivo usually ships, and it fits the phone nicely. It's not particularly flashy, but it does the job of protecting the phone. description: According to a reliable source of HMD-related leaks and rumors, the company is working on yet another lower-end Android phone to join its portfolio. It's currently unclear what this handset will be called, but it is allegedly codenamed "Darkhawk". That's probably a codename way too cool for the specs of this device. It will reportedly have a flat screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, 8GB of RAM, and a 6,000 mAh battery with support for 33W wired charging. description: Huawei has unveiled its latest Mate 90 series phones in China, with the Mate 90 Pro Max sitting at the top. The phone offers a large 6.9-inch display, a triple-rear camera setup, and supports a unique 1-inch module camera system. The triple-rear camera setup on the Mate 90 Pro Max comes with a 50MP main camera that uses a 1/1.28-inch RYYB sensor with OIS and a continuous variable f/1.4 to f/4.0 aperture. description: The vivo Y600 5G has just been listed in the Google Play Console, with the model number V2626. Its model number reveals the fact that it will be the same device as the Malaysian V80 Lite 5G as well as the Indian S2 FE, which is due to be launched on October 6. description: According to a new rumor from Samsung's home country of South Korea, the Galaxy S27 series devices will be at least KRW 130,000 (about $95) more expensive than their predecessors in the country - but that rate of increase will only apply to the base model. description: Exactly three months after being released in China, the vivo X Fold6 has now been announced for global markets, just like a rumor predicted a few days ago. The X Fold6 has an 8.02-inch foldable LTPO AMOLED screen with 2312x2504 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and 5,000-nit peak brightness, and a 6.51-inch LTPO AMOLED cover screen with 1120x2528 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and 5,000-nit peak brightness. description: Apple's very long-rumored "HomePod with a screen", sometimes referred to as the HomePad, is now said to be finally launching on October 13, according to a new report from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. title: AT&T is buying $3 billion worth of fibre optic cables from Corning
description: Today, AT&T has signed a new multi-year deal with Corning to purchase fibre optic cables. The deal is valued at more than $3 billion, and will help AT&T reach its stated goal of connecting 60 million homes and businesses with fibre optic cables by 2030. The carrier has already reached 30 million locations, so half of that, in June this year, six months ahead of its initial schedule. title: Amazon unveils faster Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) and a new Fire TV Remote
description: Amazon just unveiled a slimmer and faster Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) and a new Fire TV Remote. The stick is 20%-40% faster than similarly priced 4K sticks from other brands, says Amazon. The pricing is $60, by the way, but you can have it for half that – see below. The new Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) is powered by a quad-core 1.7GHz processor with 8GB of internal storage.
